trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy again, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback. On-call has been paged. (Note: the first attempt to create the incident timed out, but I confirmed it hadn't been created before retrying with the same idempotency key, so it was only filed once.)
